subject: Childhood Asthma and Gas Stove Health Impacts
overview: The city hosted a session of the Black Health Series focused on the intersection of environmental justice, climate change, and childhood asthma. Guest speaker Dr. Britta Lundberg presented on the disproportionate impact of indoor air pollution from gas stoves on Black communities and discussed transition strategies to electric cooking.

items.title: Introduction to Environmental Justice and Climate Equity
items.summary: City staff provided historical context on residential segregation and its link to current health disparities, noting that Black children are significantly more likely to die from asthma. The session also introduced the Climate Equity ad hoc committee, which advises on representing underrepresented groups in the city's Climate Action Plan.

items.title: Induction Cooktop Demonstration
items.summary: Climate Planner Brenda Pike demonstrated a portable induction cooktop, highlighting its energy efficiency, safety benefits, and lack of indoor air pollutants compared to gas stoves. She noted that the Medford Public Library has portable units available for residents to check out for trial use.

items.title: Presentation: Air Pollution, Climate Justice, and Childhood Asthma
items.summary: Dr. Britta Lundberg presented data identifying gas stoves as the primary indoor trigger for pediatric asthma, noting they emit nitrogen dioxide, particulate matter, and benzene even when turned off. The presentation highlighted that children in smaller homes and communities of color are disproportionately exposed to these pollutants due to poor ventilation and proximity to outdoor pollution sources.

items.title: Discussion on Mitigation and Economic Resources
items.summary: Participants discussed the impacts of leaking gas furnaces and the necessity of venting stoves to the outside rather than recirculating air. Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn and others addressed the economic barriers to transitioning appliances, noting that MassSave offers a $500 rebate for induction or electric stoves.
